release_read.basis: Q4 revenue $3.86bn against ~$3.48bn consensus and above the $3.3-3.6bn guide, non-GAAP EPS $4.43 against ~$3.27 (+35%), and an FY27 guide of $17.5-19.5bn revenue / $15.50-17.50 EPS well above the 'more than $16bn' target; the offset is a Q1 guide (EPS $3.50-3.85, op margin 7.0-7.5%) that steps down from Q4's 9.0%, which this name has sold before.
